description: Replace the commit guard's whitespace git-add split with a shell-word tokenizer so quoted/escaped paths are captured exactly, with an unterminated quote failing closed
deviation_notes: All 9 top-level tasks are done and the 3 phase checkpoints are recorded, with a push after each phase. (1) The tokenizer is deliberately bounded: it does not handle command substitution or wrapper scripts, which stay documented as a limit. (2) An unterminated quote fails closed by setting all=true (the guard then counts every changed path and may deny the commit). (3) The evidence file under measure/runs/ was force-added because .gitignore ignores the folder, matching how the repository tracks its other run evidence.
